notes.title: FULL VERSION RELEASE DATE
notes.notes:
Hello, adventure chasers!

It's been a while since we have made an announcement. We are very happy and excited at the same time to make this announcement to you. We have finally decided on a release date to launch the game. It's a very big step for us after all these efforts and blood, sweat... aaand all the other things, you know.

We've decided to release the game on the 6th of January 2022.

Firstly, we have planned to release the game in Q3 of 2021, but we admit, it was too optimistic. Then we thought we could do it in Q4 but here we are. The game is almost ready but we are making sure we left no room for bugs, errors, and etc. The localizations are almost done too. Besides these, we'll do our best to spread the word to as many people as we can to let the world know about Crowalt and Hugh's journey.

Thanks to all fans who have come this far with following us. We've put a lot of love into this game since this is our very first game to be released. We hope that it'll be a nice start and then we'll be able to show you more works of ours in the future.

Let's spread the word; 6th of Jan, 2022!

Stay safe, stay healthy.

notes.title: RUSSIAN TRANSLATION UPDATED
notes.notes:
As we've said before, we are always watching and hearing your feedback. After a couple of feedback about the [b]Russian[/b] translation, we've updated it and it's live.

Feedback regarding this update is highly appreciated by us. :)

You can now go and enjoy it, either again or for the first time!

notes.title: ENGLISH LANGUAGE & OTHER UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hi there folks,

As we said before we are looking into every single feedback that you've given (on Steam reviews, forums, social media, etc.).

We saw a couple of feedback on the English writing of the game. Now we have improved and updated it with the new patch. We'd want to see your new feedback on it.

We have also updated the five-finger fillet (knife game) difficulty. So, you might want to try it again. :)

We hope that these help for a better experience with the prologue. Every useful review helps us a lot to become better before the full release.

Don't forget to join our Discord channel for any kind of further chat with us on Crowalt:
[b]https://discord.gg/63ExNxvw[/b]

Keep on filling your soul with adventure!

See you soon. :)

notes.title: THANK YOU FOR YOUR AMAZING INTEREST
notes.notes:
Hey adventurers,

Thank you all for your amazing interest in the prologue version of [b]Crowalt: Traces of the Lost Colony[/b] so far. We are reading every single review on Steam, all comments on social media (Twitter, Reddit, Instagram, etc.), and trying to watch every video you've made on YouTube and Twitch. It's a great pleasure and also proud to see all of them.

[b]Crowalt[/b] is our first video game as a team and we've really tried to give it our best. As we see that most of you loved the idea about this game, we can't wait to see your reactions to the full version of Crowalt. The development of the full game is almost ready. Its translations are already begun to the available languages that we set on our Steam pages and the prologue.

Meanwhile, please don't forget to wishlist the full version if you liked what you've seen in the prologue. And you can join our Discord channel to keep updated and ask anything you have in mind directly:
https://discord.gg/63ExNxvw

[b]Crowalt[/b] is something that we have started creating in our hearts. We'll do our best to bring the best to you.

Thanks!
